scenes.hook: H T M L Headings Explained. Let’s make it simple.
scenes.idea: Headings organize a page into meaningful sections. Start by understanding the role it plays in a page.
scenes.code: H one is the highest heading level; H six is the lowest. Read the example from top to bottom.
scenes.result: Here’s an illustration of the result. Compare it with the example you just saw. Small changes in code can change the output.
scenes.tip: Use heading levels to describe the hierarchy of your content. Keep this detail in mind when writing your own example.
scenes.caution: Choose headings for meaning, rather than just their default size. Understanding this helps you avoid a common beginner mistake.
